assay: whole-blood bulk RNA-seq (PAXgene, polyA, NovaSeq), HISAT2 + featureCounts raw counts, GRCh38 (S2.3.p1)
sample_inclusion: 23 pediatric SCA (HbSS or S/beta0) and 17 age/ethnicity-matched healthy controls with valid RNA-seq both pre and post exercise (S2.1.p1, S3.p1, TAB1); 80 samples

factors.exercise_intensity: 50% vs 70% peak workload, pooled by the authors (S2.4.p1)

repeated_measure_unit: participant (pre and post blood draw from the same child, S2.3.p1); the paper does not state how within-subject correlation was modelled
primary_estimand: acute exercise effect (post vs pre) on whole-blood gene expression within SCA and within controls, and the group x time interaction (difference of the exercise response SCA vs CON)
planned_contrasts: post vs pre within SCA (S3.p1; paper: 391 up + 133 down = 524, P<0.01; Supp Table S2)
post vs pre within CON (S3.p1; paper: 333 up + 290 down = 623, P<0.01; Supp Table S3)
group x time interaction (S2.4.p1, S3.p1; paper: 101 up + 59 down = 160, P<0.01; Supp Table S4)
SCA vs CON at baseline, secondary/non-exercise (S3.p1; paper: 2264 genes, FDR<0.001 and +/-1.50 log2FC; Supp Table S1)
paper_method: limma-voom normalization of raw counts; limma linear models adjusted by sex with a group x time interaction term (limma v3.50.3) (S2.4.p1)
